about.bio: A passionate Digital Marketer, focused on helping businesses grow through creative strategies, data-driven marketing, and modern tools.
about.expandedBio: Over the past several years, I have partnered with ambitious founders, e-commerce labels, and B2B teams worldwide to transform ad spend into predictable revenue. By pairing sharp creative direction with disciplined media buying and Shopify conversion engineering, every campaign is built to compound brand equity alongside immediate sales.

projects.title: Social Media Campaign
projects.summary: Rebuilt short-form Reels and TikTok storytelling with creator-led hooks and interactive community challenges.
projects.strategy: Produced 24 modular vertical video hooks per month paired with retargeted engagement ads.
projects.outcome: Generated 1.4M+ organic views, tripled profile link clicks, and cut blended CAC by 34%.

projects.title: Brand Growth Strategy
projects.summary: Scaled paid acquisition from regional testing to international lead & demo generation using dynamic creative testing.
projects.strategy: Segmented cold prospect angles by pain point and paired each ad set with dedicated high-speed landing pages.
projects.outcome: Delivered 310+ qualified SQLs per quarter at a 41% lower cost per booked call.

projects.title: E-commerce Store
projects.summary: Redesigned the full Shopify shopping experience with one-click bundle upsells and Meta catalog retargeting.
projects.strategy: Streamlined mobile product pages, added trust-first social proof blocks, and launched tiered cart incentives.
projects.outcome: Lifted store conversion rate from 1.7% to 3.4% and increased average order value by 28%.

projects.title: Creative Branding
projects.summary: Crafted a futuristic 3D visual language, neon-obsidian palette, and modular social ad template suite.
projects.strategy: Unified typography, 3D icon renders, and unmistakable brand marks across every touchpoint.
projects.outcome: Boosted ad thumbstop ratio to 44% and established instant visual recall across feeds.
